train_ivf_index: train a Faiss IVF index on a subsample of database vectors and save the template file
index_shard_vectors: build sharded index files by adding transformed database vectors in batches to an IVF index
merge_index_shards: merge multiple index shard files into a single on-disk IVF index using merge_ondisk
search_ann_gpu: run large-scale approximate nearest neighbor search with GPU-accelerated big batch search across sharded index
evaluate_index_recall: evaluate ANN index quality by computing recall, intersection, and margin metrics against ground truth
